scenes.spoken: We all want NEAR to grow. But which way? What does the network need right now, and how would we know?
scenes.display: We all want NEAR to grow. But which way? What does the network need right now, and how would we know?

scenes.spoken: The answer is already out there. People say it in public, in posts, in issues, in commits. Studying all that by hand takes months. Sometimes a year.
scenes.display: The answer is already out there. People say it in public, in posts, in issues, in commits. Studying all that by hand takes months. Sometimes a year.

scenes.spoken: So we built Auto Near. It keeps reading those signals, ranks the products NEAR could use, and moves the best one toward a build. The owner sets the limits.
scenes.display: So we built AutoNEAR. It keeps reading those signals, ranks the products NEAR could use, and moves the best one toward a build. The owner sets the limits.

scenes.spoken: Thirteen sources checked in. Forty-nine feeds. Four hundred and twenty-four records, each stored with where it came from. Every one becomes a point of light.
scenes.display: 13 sources checked in. 49 feeds. 424 records, each stored with where it came from. Every one becomes a point of light.

scenes.spoken: Four hundred and eighty scores later, those points pull together into a constellation of seven product ideas.
scenes.display: 480 scores later, those points pull together into a constellation of 7 product ideas.

scenes.spoken: Then the council votes. Seven seats, one of them a skeptic, score every idea by their own rules. The vote repeats as evidence arrives. Today, treasury earns a go.
scenes.display: Then the council votes. 7 seats, one of them a skeptic, score every idea by their own rules. The vote repeats as evidence arrives. Today, treasury earns a go.

scenes.spoken: A go sends in the swarm. Five agents work one product page at once. Copy. Layout. Style. Media. Check. And a page takes shape in front of you.
scenes.display: A go sends in the swarm. Five agents work one product page at once. Copy. Layout. Style. Media. Check. And a page takes shape in front of you.

scenes.spoken: Beneath it sits a contract build, compiled, tested and given a code fingerprint. Eighty-four tests pass. The agent deploys only what the owner approved.
scenes.display: Beneath it sits a contract build, compiled, tested and given a code fingerprint. 84 tests pass. The agent deploys only what the owner approved.

scenes.spoken: Now the agent works on its own, inside the owner's limits. It draws its own gas and deploys approved code. And on NEAR testnet, the vault refused four out-of-bounds moves. Over the cap. Refused. Too many deploys. Refused. Wrong template. Refused. Paused. Refused.
scenes.display: Now the agent works on its own, inside the owner's limits. It draws its own gas and deploys approved code. And on NEAR testnet, the vault refused 4 out-of-bounds moves. Over the cap. Refused. Too many deploys. Refused. Wrong template. Refused. Paused. Refused.
scenes.tag: PUBLIC TESTNET · DEMO OWNER KEY · AUTOMATED

scenes.spoken: And the owner always has the final word. Hold to approve. Pause or revoke at any moment. A wrong fingerprint is refused. A human stays on the brake.
scenes.display: And the owner always has the final word. Hold to approve. Pause or revoke at any moment. A wrong fingerprint is refused. A human stays on the brake.
scenes.tag: RECORDED RUN · FIXTURE INPUTS · MOCKED RPC

scenes.spoken: Next, the community joins in. People will test each build and confirm it before it goes live.
scenes.display: Next, the community joins in. People will test each build and confirm it before it goes live.

scenes.spoken: Auto Near. Public signals in. A product you can inspect. A human on the brake. Judges, clone the repo and run the tests.
scenes.display: AutoNEAR. Public signals in. A product you can inspect. A human on the brake. Judges, clone the repo and run the tests.
